transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I've got a cough, and pain in my right side.

Could you tell me a bit about when the cough and the pain in your right side first started—whether they came on suddenly or gradually, and if anything seemed to set them off—and also whether you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
It started two days ago.
How much are the cough and the pain affecting you from day to day, and could you tell me about any medicines you take regularly or have taken recently, including anything new or changed?
My daughter keeps telling me to take it easy these days.
Do you have any allergies to medicines, or have you ever had a bad reaction to a medicine?
No, nothing like that.
Have you had any ongoing health conditions in the past that you’ve seen a doctor about regularly?
Yes, I have high blood pressure.
How much are the cough and the pain in your right side bothering you these days?
The pain only comes on when I cough.
Have you noticed anything else bothering you since the cough started?
I've been feeling a bit nauseous.
Are you taking any medicines at the moment — only your usual ones, something new or changed recently, none at all, or are you not sure?
I take something for my blood pressure, that's all I know.
How much do the cough and side pain bother you day to day?
My son visited last Sunday, that was nice.
Besides high blood pressure, do you see a doctor or nurse for anything else?
Yes, I have macular degeneration.
Do the cough and side pain come and go, or stay?
I haven't really noticed it coming and going.
Since the cough and pain in your right side began, have you noticed any changes in your appetite, sleep, weight, or energy, or has all that stayed about the same?
I've felt feverish with chills at home.
What worries you most about this?
I just hope it's not like the pneumonia last year.
Can you tell me what the pain in your right side feels like?
I can't really describe it. It's just there when I cough.
Aside from your high blood pressure, macular degeneration, and the pneumonia last year, is there anything else you’ve been treated for or take medicine for, or is that all?
No, that's all.
How are you sleeping at night since this started, if it has changed at all?
I've not noticed anything different with my sleep.
Since this started, have you noticed any changes in your bladder or bowel habits, or any changes in your breathing?
No, I haven't noticed anything like that.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
